english.title: PHV operator provide vehicle - no driver/vehicle licence in force - London
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the operator of a London private hire vehicle, failed to secure that a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), provided by you for carrying out a private hire booking accepted by you in London was

(A)_[a vehicle for which a London private hire vehicle licence was in force driven by a person holding a London private hire vehicle driver's licence]_
(B)_[a London cab driven by a person holding a London cab driver's licence]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 4(2) and (5) of the Private Hire Vehicles (London) Act 1998.
